title: Pneumatics & hydraulics
circuit: Two double-acting cylinders, 5/2 double-pilot valves, rollers a0/a1/b0/b1, START: A+ B+ B− A− on a two-group cascade (see circuit.md)

candidates.name: Pad-native pneumatic
candidates.oneLine: Discrete-event engine behind ISO 1219 SVG in pad inks, live displacement-step diagram
candidates.accuracy: check-pad-native-pneumatic.mjs runs the engine in Node: A+ B+ B− A−, no pilot conflict, circuit.md step table, return to rest, naive wiring caught (24/24 PASS)
candidates.caveats: Kinematic model (constant piston speed, instant lines). Hand-placed layout for this one circuit; no solenoids, 5/3, timers or hydraulics yet.

candidates.name: Picuino neumatic v2.9
candidates.oneLine: Open-source canvas pneumatic simulator, self-hosted, running its own A+ B+ B− A− cascade example
candidates.accuracy: Observed only: polled both cylinders in the browser after one INIT press, A+ B+ B− A− then home. No Node gate (engine tied to canvas).
candidates.caveats: Mouse-only; 500 px canvas cut off on a phone. Full editor chrome shown to students. GPL-3.0, one maintainer.

candidates.name: MechSimulator (benchmark only)
candidates.oneLine: Link-out plus notes: cannot be framed or mirrored, kept as look-and-feel benchmark
candidates.accuracy: not checked: closed and not embeddable; its Cascade preset started A+ when pressed, full order not verified
candidates.caveats: Opens in a new tab with analytics/ad cookies. Dark glowing dashboard look. Its diagram header mislabelled the cascade as A+ B+ A− B−.
